The 5 oz Silver Bullet Elemental Box from Bullion Trading LLC offers a unique product to firearms enthusiasts, collectors, and investors alike. Each box includes 4 splendid bullets, each made from .999 pure silver and modeled after the 12 Gauge shotgun shell, a well-known and frequently used shell in the United States.
This distinctive Elemental Box provides an excellent investment opportunity for those looking to diversify their portfolio with unique silver items. Each bullet in the box has a diameter of 0.81 inches and a length of 2.99 inches, making a significant and eye-catching addition to any collection or investment.
In addition to the 5 oz Silver Bullet Elemental Box, Bullion Trading LLC also offers individual 1 oz and 2 oz silver bullets. The 1 oz silver bullet is designed based on the .45 ACP caliber round, while the 2 oz silver bullet draws inspiration from the .308 caliber round. Each of these products is made of .999 pure silver.
You can purchase the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set, as well as the individual 1 oz and 5 oz versions, from Bullion Trading LLC by visiting the following links:
1 oz Silver Bullet (.45) box:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/1-oz-silver-bullet/
2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/2-oz-silver-bullet/
1 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/1-oz-silver-bullet/
5 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/5-oz-silver-bullet/
For any queries or concerns about the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set or the individual silver bullets offered by Bullion Trading LLC, you can reach their customer service team via email at
[email protected]
, or by calling 646-362-3536.
